title: Eoptic, Inc. Selected to Supply DeepScan™ Imaging Payloads Scheduled for Launch in 2027
summary: Eoptic, Inc. has been selected to supply DeepScan™ imaging payloads for a launch scheduled in 2027. The company, based in Rochester, NY, specializes in advanced multi-spectral and multi-modal imaging systems.

title: New report takes closer look at the Space Force spending surge
summary: A new report by Aerospace Corp. reveals that the Space Force's spending surge is primarily focused on classified programs, target tracking, missile warning, and command and control. Most of the growth in funding is concentrated in these areas.

title: NRO to expand use of HawkEye 360’s satellite intelligence
summary: The NRO has awarded a contract to HawkEye 360 to expand the U.S. government's access to satellite intelligence for locating electronic emitters like radars and ships. This deal enhances the government's capabilities in tracking and monitoring such signals from space.

title: HEO to use Planet satellites for non-Earth imaging
summary: HEO, an Australian company specializing in non-Earth imaging of spacecraft, has partnered with Planet to access its satellite data. This collaboration will enhance HEO's capabilities in monitoring and analyzing objects in space.

title: New EU sanctions target leaders of Russia’s space industry
summary: The European Union has imposed sanctions targeting the head of a Roscosmos subsidiary involved in developing a synthetic aperture radar satellite system for Russia's military. This action is part of broader EU measures against Russia's space industry.

title: ULA names Peller as new CEO
summary: United Launch Alliance (ULA) has appointed Mark Peller, a long-time executive, as its new CEO. Peller succeeds Tory Bruno, who led the company for over a decade.

title: L3Harris names space sector leader Sam Mehta CEO after Kubasik steps down
summary: L3Harris has appointed Sam Mehta as CEO of its space sector following the resignation of Christopher Kubasik due to an unspecified conduct investigation. The leadership change aims to drive growth in the company's space division.

title: The 77th International Astronautical Congress (IAC 2026) is the One Space Event You Cannot Miss
summary: The 77th International Astronautical Congress (IAC 2026) is highlighted as a must-attend event for the global space community, marking over 75 years of annual gatherings.

title: SEOPS adds second Waymaker rideshare mission
summary: SEOPS, a launch services provider, has announced a second Waymaker rideshare mission due to high demand, following the success of a mission announced just three months prior.

title: A rocket crashed into the moon. It was harmless, but the next one might not be.
summary: A discarded SpaceX Falcon 9 upper stage crashed into the moon at high speed. Experts warn future uncontrolled lunar impacts could pose risks.

title: See gorgeous views of the Aug. 12 total solar eclipse captured from space
summary: Orbiting spacecraft captured stunning images of the Aug. 12 total solar eclipse, showing the moon's shadow darkening Earth. The event provided a unique perspective from space.

title: Watch European astronaut make history during spacewalk today
summary: European Space Agency astronaut Sophie Adenot will become the first French woman to perform a spacewalk on Aug. 18. The historic event can be watched live.

title: How an ancient collision with another galaxy transformed the Milky Way
summary: A recent study reveals that an ancient collision with another galaxy significantly transformed the Milky Way. This discovery sheds light on the galaxy's hidden merger history.

title: China bounces back from Long March rocket explosion with back-to-back launches (video)
summary: China resumed space launches following a Long March 7A rocket explosion on Aug. 10, successfully deploying a Long March 12 and Long March 2C rocket on Aug. 16. The back-to-back launches mark a recovery for the country's space program.

title: The best Ruko drone to date is half-price at Amazon but you'll have to hurry
summary: The Ruko F11 PRO 2 drone is currently available at a 50% discount on Amazon, priced at $280. This limited-time offer is expected to end soon.

title: Scientists find dead star that predicts our sun's future: 'Broken apart and returned to the galaxy'
summary: Scientists discovered a dead star that provides insights into the future of our sun, showing how it may 'break apart and return to the galaxy'. The Helix Nebula, observed using data from Hubble and other telescopes, reveals bow shocks.

title: The 1st 'Star Wars: Ahsoka' season 2 trailer finally gives us a release date (video)
summary: The first trailer for 'Star Wars: Ahsoka' season 2 has been released, revealing the upcoming season's release date and showcasing epic space battles, Clone Wars flashbacks, and appearances by Anakin Skywalker.

title: Scientists find 3 supermassive black holes on the verge of collision inside a distant galaxy
summary: Scientists discovered three supermassive black holes on the verge of collision in a distant galaxy that existed less than 1.3 billion years after the Big Bang. This rare finding provides insights into the early universe and galaxy formation.

title: On this day in space! Aug. 17, 1877: Asaph Hall discovers the Martian moon Phobos
summary: On August 17, 1877, American astronomer Asaph Hall discovered Phobos, one of Mars' two moons. This historic finding marked a significant milestone in early space exploration.

title: Wildfire smoke blankets volcanoes across the Pacific Northwest | Space photo of the day for Aug. 17, 2026
summary: Wildfires in North America have produced large smoke plumes, as captured in a space photo on August 17, 2026. The smoke blankets volcanoes across the Pacific Northwest.

title: Launch Preview: Chang’e 7 headlines week of Chinese and Starlink launches
summary: China is preparing for the Chang'e 7 lunar mission following a recent launch failure of the Chang Zheng 7A rocket. The week also includes multiple Starlink satellite launches.

title: Firefly promote next block of Alpha amid Eclipse progress
summary: Firefly Aerospace is advancing the development of its next-generation medium-lift rocket while also making progress on its Eclipse program. The company is promoting its upcoming Alpha rocket block amid these advancements.

title: Blue Origin overviews plan for dual pad ops at Cape Canaveral
summary: Blue Origin is planning dual launch pad operations at Cape Canaveral as it restores its primary launch pad at LC-36A. The company has outlined its strategy for expanding launch capabilities at the site.

title: Rocket Lab advances via series of announcements
summary: Rocket Lab has established a new subsidiary in Germany and introduced a containerized mobile launch system. The company is expanding its global presence and launch capabilities.

title: Amid failure, Wenchang celebrates milestone as China launches AI satellites and prepares for lunar south pole mission
summary: China's Wenchang Space Launch Site celebrated its 50th launch milestone while also experiencing a failure. The site launched AI satellites and is preparing for a future lunar south pole mission.

title: Starbase Production lining up future vehicles
summary: SpaceX's Starbase production site is progressing with the assembly of multiple Starship vehicles. This indicates ongoing efforts to scale up production for future missions.

title: Launch Preview: Chinese failure opens busy international launch salvo
summary: A Chinese launch failure on Aug. 10 led to a busy week of international launches, with four missions across three countries. The incident highlighted the challenges and risks in spaceflight operations.

title: Artemis progress building lunar return roadmap
summary: NASA has released updates on the Artemis program, detailing progress toward a lunar return. The updates include plans for commercial robotic lunar missions.

title: Blue Origin working engine resolutions and dual pad future
summary: Blue Origin is nearing the end of its investigation into a catastrophic engine explosion. The company is also planning for a dual launch pad future.

title: Relativity Space engine integration milestone for Terran-R first stage
summary: Relativity Space has achieved a key milestone in integrating engines for the first stage of its reusable Terran-R rocket. This marks progress in the development of the company's next-generation launch vehicle.

title: TEC Business to Business website
summary: The news source is a B2B website focused on the technology, engineering, and construction sectors, covering business-related content in these industries.

title: ESA Delivers: 50 years booklet
summary: ESA celebrates its 50th anniversary by releasing a booklet highlighting 50 major achievements over the past five decades. The publication underscores the agency's contributions to space exploration and technology.

title: Phoenix 3: concept study for a reusable European spacecraft
summary: Engineers from ESA and industry partners completed a concept study for Phoenix 3, a reusable spacecraft for microgravity experiments and Earth return.

title: Proba-3’s eclipse hours before totality in Europe
summary: Proba-3 mission will create an artificial solar eclipse hours before the total solar eclipse in Europe. The mission aims to study the Sun's corona.

title: A double eclipse for Proba-3
summary: Proba-3, a space mission, captured a double eclipse where the Moon crossed its field of view. This event highlights the mission's precise formation-flying capabilities.

title: How ESA mimics and models the 2026 total solar eclipse
summary: ESA is preparing to study the 2026 total solar eclipse by using artificial eclipse missions and computer models to simulate the event. This approach allows scientists to observe the Sun's corona for extended periods, which is crucial for solar research.

title: Your chance to run software in deep space on ESA's asteroid mission
summary: ESA is inviting European researchers and companies to run their software aboard the Hera mission, which will travel millions of kilometers into deep space. This offers a unique opportunity to test software in a real deep-space environment.

title: From drone flight to sounding rocket
summary: A student-developed radar retroreflector technology was tested for the first time using a drone at ESA's ESTEC technical center in the Netherlands. The payload transitioned from drone flight to sounding rocket testing.

title: Earth and Proba-3’s Coronagraph play hide and seek
summary: ESA's Proba-3 mission will demonstrate formation flying by using a coronagraph to block the Sun's glare and observe the solar corona, while Earth and the spacecraft engage in coordinated maneuvers. This technology aims to enhance future space-based solar observations.

title: Meet space startups at ESA’s Industry Space Days
summary: ESA's Industry Space Days event will showcase innovative space startups and foster collaboration with Europe's space industry on September 16-17 at ESA-ESTEC in the Netherlands.

title: HEO Taps Planet Labs to Expand its NEI Network
summary: HEO has partnered with Planet Labs to expand its NEI network to over 50 in-space sensors, enabling customers to capture more frequent and high-resolution images of objects in orbit from multiple angles.

title: DIU, SDA Select Winners for Deorbit-as-a-Service Designs
summary: The Space Development Agency (SDA) and Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) selected three companies to design scalable satellite capabilities for rendezvous, capture, and deorbit. This initiative aims to enhance satellite servicing and debris mitigation in orbit.

title: SEOPS Doubles Down on Waymaker Dedicated Rideshare Program
summary: SEOPS is expanding its Waymaker dedicated rideshare program to fill the gap left by SpaceX's Transporter program, offering cost-effective rides to orbit for space startups.

title: The New Middle Ground in Spacecraft Development
summary: The commercial space industry is shifting towards customers building their own spacecraft hardware for full mission ownership, moving beyond affordability and accessibility. This trend reflects a new focus on customization and control in spacecraft development.

title: Exclusive: Reflect Orbital Responds to its Critics
summary: Reflect Orbital faces criticism over its sunlight-reflecting satellites, with the space community divided on the idea. The company has responded to these concerns.

title: NASA Opens Call on Moon Base Health Research
summary: NASA's Human Research Program is soliciting research proposals for health studies related to long-term stays at a Moon Base. The initiative aims to address medical and biological challenges for future lunar missions.

title: Rocket Lab Enters Europe’s Crowded Launch Market
summary: Rocket Lab is entering Europe's competitive launch market, surprising local companies as they return from holiday. The move marks Rocket Lab's expansion into a new region.

title: Exclusive: Space Kinetic Awarded $50M for Space Maneuverability
summary: Space Kinetic secured a $50 million OTA award from the U.S. Space Force to develop Whirlwind, a space maneuverability and deployment system. This funding will advance capabilities for in-space operations and satellite positioning.

title: How to Pitch the Space Force: Green and Red Flags
summary: A Space Force official discussed key factors for startups to consider when pitching for award opportunities. The article highlights green flags and red flags in applications to improve success rates.

title: Astranis Unveils Perceptor, an SDA Product for GEO
summary: Astranis developed Perceptor, an SDA product designed to address issues with existing technology while operating in geostationary orbit (GEO). The tool aims to improve capabilities in this orbital regime.

title: Katalyst Space Wins U.S. Defense Innovation Unit Contract
summary: Katalyst Space secured a contract from the U.S. Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) to develop deorbiting technologies. The deal highlights the growing role of private companies in advancing space debris mitigation for national security.

title: Peru Taps Gilat for Connectivity Program
summary: Gilat Satellite Networks secured a $14 million connectivity deal in Peru to provide satellite services to its population of around 35 million people.

title: Lynk and Omnispace Completer Merger – Announce Elveo Mobile
summary: Lynk and Omnispace have completed their merger to form a new company called Elveo Mobile. The combined entity aims to advance mobile satellite communications.

title: Sovereign Data at Tactical Speeds: BlackSky CTO Patrick O’Neil on the Shifts in Adoption of Space-based Intelligence
summary: Conflicts worldwide have increased the demand for space-based intelligence from governments and military departments. BlackSky's CTO discusses the growing adoption and cost dynamics of satellite-based intelligence.

title: Space Force Awards Space Data Network Contracts to Five Satellite Manufacturers
summary: The U.S. Space Force awarded contracts to five satellite manufacturers to develop a more diverse multi-vendor architecture for its space data network. This move aims to enhance resilience and flexibility in military satellite communications.

title: Astranis Unveils Perceptor Space Domain Awareness GEO Satellite
summary: Astranis announced the unveiling of its new 'Perceptor' satellite, designed for space domain awareness and maneuverability in GEO orbit. This marks Astranis' latest initiative in the space industry.

title: CesiumAstro Acquires Semiconductor Company Jariet Technologies
summary: CesiumAstro has acquired Jariet Technologies, a semiconductor company, to enhance its communications and sensing systems for commercial, civil, and national security customers.

title: Planet Labs to Support Government, Public Services in Rwanda
summary: The Rwanda Government is partnering with Planet Labs to launch a new national program leveraging satellite technology for government and public services. This collaboration aims to enhance Rwanda's capabilities in using satellite data for various applications.

title: Mantis Space Appoints Ex-Boeing Exec as CTO
summary: Mantis Space has appointed Dale Parkes, a former Boeing executive, as its new Chief Technology Officer (CTO). The appointment coincides with the company's efforts to develop a constellation of spacecraft for continuous Earth orbit operations.

title: Impulse Space Wins New Space Force Contract
summary: Impulse Space has secured a $28 million SBIR Phase III contract extension with the U.S. Space Force to support two missions. This contract highlights the company's growing role in national security space operations.
